title: Fix Grid & List View Toggle in My Files Section

requirements.summary: Fix the Grid & List view toggle in the 'My Files' section so that clicking the grid or list view icon in the FileToolbar actually switches the file display area between grid layout and list layout
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the grid view icon in the FileToolbar switches the file display area to a multi-column grid layout.
Clicking the list view icon in the FileToolbar switches the file display area to a single-column list layout.
The active/selected view icon is visually highlighted to indicate the current view mode.
The view mode state persists correctly within the session (does not reset unexpectedly on re-render).
The toggle works consistently in the My Files (Dashboard) section.

file_operations.description: Add viewMode and onViewModeChange props to the FileToolbar component. Wire the grid and list view toggle buttons to call onViewModeChange with the appropriate mode ('grid' or 'list'). Apply visual highlighting (e.g., different background color, border, or opacity) to the active view button based on the current viewMode prop to indicate which view is selected.

Add viewMode state using useState with a default value of 'grid'. Pass viewMode and a setViewMode callback to the FileToolbar component. Implement conditional rendering logic that displays files and folders in a multi-column grid layout when viewMode is 'grid' and in a single-column list layout when viewMode is 'list'. Ensure grid layout uses CSS grid or flexbox with multiple columns and list layout uses a single column with row-based items. Maintain all existing functionality (search, sort, filter, pagination, preview, favorite, move, delete, rename) in both view modes.

Verify that the FileList component is rendered without any props that would override its internal viewMode state. Ensure the Dashboard does not pass conflicting state or props that would interfere with the FileList's view toggle functionality. Test that the view mode toggle works correctly when navigating between folders and that the selected view mode persists within the session as long as the component remains mounted.
